paragraphs: R. Yishmael bar Naḥman, Vayikra Rabbah, chapters 13 and 17; Yelammedenu, Ekev (bar Neḥemyah). R. Berekhya said in R. Ḥelbo's name. In Tzav, chapter 9: bar Rav Naḥman.
